definitions.explanation: The area or direction behind something or someone. A somewhat formal word for the space to the rear.

examples.japanese: {後方|こうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
{後方|こうほう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧きた。
examples.english: An ambulance was approaching from behind.

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後方|こうほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}ったら→座る：00757_suwaru⟧、⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどかった→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
examples.english: When I sat in the seats at the back of the bus, the shaking was terrible.

notes:
{後方|こうほう} means the rear or the area behind. More formal than ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧, often used in driving, military, and public announcement contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後方|こうほう}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: rear check (driving)
- {後方|こうほう}⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧: rear support, logistics (military)
- {後方|こうほう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from behind
- {後方|こうほう}⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: watch your back

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前方|ぜんぽう}→前方：19125_zenpou⟧: the front, ahead (opposite)
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧: behind (everyday, casual)
- {後方|こうほう}: behind (formal, technical)

WATCH OUT:
⟦{広報|こうほう}→広報：05228_kouhou⟧ (public relations) has the same pronunciation but completely different meaning and kanji.
